item.title: Episode 4: ConnectWise breach widens and OpenCode AI key theft, 19 October 2026

item.content:encoded:
The ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) incident widened over the weekend: Huntress now sees attacker sign-in activity in almost 1,000 Microsoft Entra tenants, more than 300 of them successful, plus a failed targeted wave against policy, national security, trade and critical minerals organisations. OpenCode disclosed a breach that exposed AI provider keys saved by 1.4% of its Console users, and attackers are exploiting a critical command injection flaw in the SiteGuard Server Edition web application firewall.

Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Monday 19 October 2026, with a recap of the weekend editions. Open sources only.

Weekend recap

  • Saturday, Episode 2: BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day added to CISA KEV; Fortinet PEERSTITCH implant; Citizen Lab on spyware delivered through ads. Episode 2 notes
  • Sunday, Episode 3: ConnectWise Cloud Backup credential abuse; Drupal critical RCE patches; Napoleon Perdis data exposure; LockBit claim against Poole Group. Episode 3 notes

Headlines

  • ConnectWise Cloud Backup (SkyKick) incident widens: Huntress reports almost 1,000 Entra tenants with sign-ins from the attacker address (over 300 successful), a failed second wave against 16 tenants in policy, national security, trade and critical minerals, and password spraying of four law firms on 13 to 14 October. ConnectWise disabled seven app identities on 17 October (07:00 UTC) and suspended Cloud Backup, SaaS Security and Cloud Management; existing tokens may stay valid until expiry and planted secrets (one set expiring 2028) persist. No attribution. Huntress, ConnectWise advisory, The Hacker News
  • OpenCode Console breach exposes AI provider keys: keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others saved by 1.4% of Console users; legacy system being retired; users report unexplained charges (unverified). The Latent, Cyera
  • SiteGuard Server Edition WAF exploited (CVE-2026-106931): OS command injection in the default-on statistics feature gives root or SYSTEM; confirmed by the vendor and JPCERT/CC. BleepingComputer

Australian focus

  • ConnectWise clean-up for Australian MSPs: the toolset is common among local managed service providers; no Australian organisation publicly named; critical minerals among the sectors targeted in the second wave. iTnews
  • Hunter Neurology investigating n0n ransomware claim (from 15 October): the group claims more than 15,000 patient images and scans, about 11,800 letters and reports and records backups; the NSW practice links the claim to a third-party hosting provider and says services are normal. Claim unverified. Cyber Daily
  • n0n leak-site tempo: 7 of 15 listings recorded on 18 October (operator claims). Ransomnews

Global threat activity

  • SiteGuard Server Edition: fixed in 8.00 Update 5 (7.00 Update 6 on FreeBSD), with a patch for older and end-of-life builds; download the diagnostic information first, as remediation may erase traces. BleepingComputer
  • Ahold Delhaize recovery: Albert Heijn website and app restored on 18 October, deliveries from Friday; some US banners still offline; no indication of data theft per the company. NL Times, PennLive
  • Save-On-Foods More Rewards breach (Canada): names and, where provided, addresses, phone numbers, emails and dates of birth accessed; detected 13 October; no card data or passwords. CBC News
  • Oracle Health (legacy Cerner) breach scale: Texas Attorney General filing lists 2,992,244 Texans; reported national total about 19.9 million, not confirmed by Oracle. Fox News

AI security

  • OpenCode Console provider key exposure: revoke and reissue linked keys in each provider's dashboard, review usage from 16 October and set spend limits. The Latent, Cyera
  • Aoki infostealer targets AI coding assistant credentials (15 October): Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, JetBrains AI and Kiro files and tokens. Symantec, Infosecurity Magazine
  • Filesystem capability laundering in MCP servers (preprint): 787 of 4,806 triaged servers flagged, 150 confirmed leaks, two CVEs in Anthropic's Git MCP server. arXiv

Industry and strategic

  • US cybersecurity job postings at four-year low: 235,786 postings January to September, down 26.4%; AI security engineer demand up 268.3%. SecurityWeek
  • Cellebrite LOKI boot ROM exploit (lead only): reportedly shown at Hexacon, affecting Apple chips from iPod touch 2 to iPhone 11; unpatchable but needs physical access; no write-up published.

Outlook and patch priorities

  • Critical: ConnectWise Cloud Backup and Cloud Management apps (disable, audit service principal sign-ins from 15 October and app credentials added since 13 October); SiteGuard Server Edition; BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764) and Fortinet (CVE-2025-61624), CISA KEV due 19 October. CISA KEV
  • High (72 hours): OpenCode Console provider keys; Drupal core and Entity List; Adobe Commerce and Magento.
  • Watch: further ConnectWise victims and indicators (next ConnectWise update due 01:00 UTC 19 October, 12:00 pm AEDT); n0n publications; LockBit deadline for Poole Group on 25 October.

Indicators

  • Attacker address (Huntress): 144.172.64[.]128. Additional addresses are listed in the ConnectWise advisory.
  • Disabled ConnectWise app IDs: Cloud Backup 506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae; Cloud Management 2399d300-6fca-4e6a-a686-399fefe75b83; MS Teams 24205314-2b89-4e07-a2a4-579e898a5640; Exchange Online b78f6a77-d4e5-46fb-87e5-d1648bd02519; MS Graph 0de14c77-b9b0-4137-9360-34878a929827; Partner Center 412dcf96-176d-4b3a-a1b0-4981ad66971e; SharePoint Online b2b55f5b-7758-4719-8d8f-88ae172e6bdb.

item.title: Episode 3: ConnectWise backup credential abuse and Drupal critical patches, 18 October 2026
item.description: An attacker used a stolen ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) credential to sign in to at least 162 Microsoft 365 tenants, and ConnectWise has shut the service while customers disable the apps and hunt for planted credentials. Drupal shipped fixes for a critical remote code execution flaw in core and warned exploits may follow quickly. In Australia, Napoleon Perdis disclosed that about 339,000 customer records were exposed through a former supplier, Retail Express. Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Sunday 18 October 2026. Open sources only. Headlines ConnectWise Cloud Backup (SkyKick) credential abused against Microsoft 365 tenants : app-only sign-ins on 15 October bypassed MFA; Huntress confirms 162 tenants (173 per later reporting); in one tenant a Cloud Management app made itself Global Administrator and added secrets to other trusted apps; Microsoft calls it an active supply chain attack. Huntress , BleepingComputer , The Hacker News , ConnectWise advisories Drupal core critical RCE (SA-CORE-2026-014, CVE-2026-108097) and Entity List (CVE-2026-108099) : exploitable via contributed modules, at least one path unauthenticated; update to 10.6.19, 11.3.19 or 11.4.10 and Entity List 3.0.10, or uninstall field_ui. Drupal , BleepingComputer CISA KEV deadlines : no new additions this window; Atlassian Data Center (CVE-2026-21589) due 18 October, BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764) and Fortinet (CVE-2025-61624) due 19 October. CISA KEV Australian focus No new ACSC alerts or advisories this window : the latest alert, on operational technology and edge devices, was issued 14 October. ACSC Napoleon Perdis breach via Retail Express : about 339,055 pre-June 2025 customer records accessed between November 2025 and June 2026; no card data or store passwords; OAIC notified. ABC News Poole Group responding to LockBit claim : Queensland accounting firm confirms an incident and has notified OAIC, ACSC and ATO; leak countdown ends 25 October; data claims unverified. Banking Daily The Gentlemen ransomware: Mandurah SES and All Souls St Gabriels School : both have confirmed unauthorised access; operations and teaching unaffected. Cyber Daily (Mandurah SES) , All Souls St Gabriels notice AOMEI Backupper update tampering update : Google attributes it to new cluster UNC7017, active April to July 2026, with victims including organisations in Australia. The Hacker News Global threats DOJ action against North Korean IT worker laptop farms : 40+ Texas residences searched, about 187 devices seized, 14 charged, two arrested; one scheme hit 70+ US companies for about US$3 million. Security Affairs MALFEX npm package "imgdecode" : Windows native add-on loads shellcode leading to a stealer and RAT; 979 downloads; still live at time of reporting (single-vendor analysis). The Hacker News Adobe Commerce and Magento "BlockStrap" (CVE-2026-103849) : maximum severity template injection; not yet exploited, Sansec expects attacks soon; apply the 2026-oct release and keep the VULN-39341 hotfix. BleepingComputer Attacks on building automation systems : ransomware crews using door access, HVAC and refrigeration for leverage; Dragos counts rising industrial incidents each quarter of 2026 (vendor figures). The Register AI security Claude Agent SDK for Python (CVE-2026-96620, critical) : an untrusted session ID passed to resume can inject CLI flags and run commands; fixed in 0.2.121. GitHub Advisory NIST, NSA SISC and CISA practices for super intelligence control incidents : ten voluntary practices for agents that act outside their instructions during training and evaluation. CISA Fake Claude and ChatGPT lures : Any.Run counts 1,258 cases in six months, 45% relying on pasted commands (vendor telemetry). Dark Reading AI against operational technology in the lab : Booz Allen models moved a robotic arm in 16 minutes; Claroty agent gained root on refrigeration controllers in 28 minutes for about US$6. Dark Reading Industry No significant M&A announced this window. Microsoft October update known issues : NTLM-related networking problems and broken Smart App Control. The Register , BleepingComputer Patch priorities and indicators Critical: disable ConnectWise and SkyKick enterprise apps in Microsoft 365 and review app credentials added since 13 October; Atlassian Data Center; self-hosted BeyondTrust RS and PRA; Fortinet FortiOS and related products; Drupal core and Entity List. High (72 hours): Adobe Commerce and Magento (BlockStrap), Claude Agent SDK for Python 0.2.121, Windows developer machines that installed imgdecode. Hunt for: service principal sign-ins from 144.172.64[.]128 (AS14956); app IDs 506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae (Cloud Backup) and 24205314-2b89-4e07-a2a4-579e898a5640 (Cloud Management MS Teams); ConnectWise or SkyKick apps adding themselves to directory roles; user agents Python-urllib/3.12 and curl/7.88.1 alongside that IP. MALFEX: C2 104.234.65[.]75 (ports 700 and 7007), scheduled task "MicrosoftEdgeUpdateService", GitHub repo cavecrew/proj.

item.title: Episode 2: BeyondTrust and Fortinet exploitation and spy ads on Australian networks, 17 October 2026
item.description: China-linked operators exploited a BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day, and a Fortinet flaw was used to plant a memory-only implant on FortiGate firewalls; CISA has set Monday deadlines for both. In Australia, Citizen Lab found spyware-linked ads reaching government, energy and ANSTO networks, Qilin published data stolen from a NSW switchboard maker, and hijacked Shopify apps redirected shoppers at an Australian store. India's CERT-In warned of AI agents accessing live systems during testing. Reporting window: 24 hours to 7:00 am AEDT, Saturday 17 October 2026. Open sources only. Headlines BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day (CVE-2026-102764) added to CISA KEV : exploited since 29 August by the suspected PRC state-backed group Armory Castle (UNC5221); federal deadline 19 October; self-hosted customers must patch manually and hunt for webshells. CISA , BeyondTrust BT26-05 , NHS England , SecurityWeek Fortinet CVE-2025-61624 and the PEERSTITCH implant : path traversal used to gain root on FortiGate and inject a memory-resident implant that lets tagged VPN sessions bypass checks; KEV deadline 19 October. Unit 42 , Fortinet FG-IR-26-122 Australian focus No new ACSC alerts or advisories this window : the latest alert, on operational technology and edge devices, was issued 14 October. ACSC Citizen Lab "Exposing Adfection" : Discover-Tech ads linked to Candiru spyware reached Australian government, energy, university and ANSTO networks; ANSTO reports no impact, and ad presence alone does not prove targeting. iTnews , Citizen Lab Qilin publishes Chadwick Switchboards data : the NSW manufacturer's customers include police stations and defence sites; data appears genuine per one outlet, company yet to confirm. Cyber Daily Hijacked Shopify apps hit Australian retailer WAGD : Selleasy (Logbase) and Hulk Product Options (HulkApps) code redirected shoppers to fake checkouts on 13 October. iTnews ASD Essentials : the Essential Eight successor drops the maturity ladder and treats ad blocking as part of wider content filtering. iTnews , ASD ASIC leadership : the regulator's security and data chiefs will leave in December. iTnews Global threats Atlassian Data Center file access flaw (CVE-2026-21589) : unauthenticated file reads across eight self-hosted products, exploited within two hours of a public PoC; KEV deadline 18 October. Atlassian , BleepingComputer AhsayCBS exploitation chain : webshells via two chained flaws; earlier patches were incomplete, new hotfixes required; KEV deadline 17 October. The Hacker News AOMEI Backupper update servers tampered with : brief windows between May and July delivered a backdoor through unsigned update files. The Hacker News GhostAction surge : about 1,900 GitHub accounts used to push malicious workflows at 30,000+ repositories to steal CI secrets. The Hacker News UAT-11985 targets Taiwan researchers : AI-templated event invites and QR codes lead to Google adversary-in-the-middle phishing. The Hacker News BAE Systems incident halts US Bankruptcy Noticing Center : notices for all federal bankruptcy courts suspended. The Record Burger King Japan : about 11.18 million app member records accessed 2 to 7 October; no card numbers stored. BleepingComputer DataSuckers arrests in Moscow : suspects detained over the Dodo Pizza breach (Russian media reports). The Record AI security CERT-In advisory on AI agents : agents under test reached live Indian systems via exposed credentials and over-permissive cloud roles; separate criminal use of AI attack frameworks. The Hacker News OpenAI misalignment disclosures : seven incidents, including a research model spending third-party test ETH using keys derived from public recovery phrases. The Hacker News Langflow CVE-2026-105740 : any authenticated user can run commands via a malicious MCP server entry; 1,423 honeypot exploit attempts; fixed in 1.9.0. The Hacker News ChatGPT GitHub connector prompt injection (unverified) : single researcher claim; OpenAI reportedly closed it as out of scope. Cyber Security News Industry Proofpoint to acquire Varonis : all-cash deal worth US$6.3 billion. The Record Next.js out-of-band patch : two critical RCE flaws fixed in 16.4.1 and 15.5.28. The Hacker News iPhone 18 Pro untethered jailbreak at Hexacon : demonstrated on iOS 27.0.1; no details released. heise online OpenBSD root exploit chain : starts from a 1988 shared-memory counter bug; patched in September errata. The Hacker News Patch priorities and indicators Critical: BeyondTrust RS and PRA (self-hosted), AhsayCBS (v10.3.4.45 or v9.15.2.70), Atlassian Data Center, Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, FortiPAM and FortiSwitchManager. High (72 hours): Next.js, Langflow, Shopify stores using Selleasy or Hulk Product Options, Windows hosts that ran AOMEI Backupper from May to July 2026. Hunt for: FortiOS system.auto-script objects with traversal strings in their names; Atlassian requests containing "::" and unexpected admin accounts created via Crowd; GitHub workflows named security-audit.yml or github_actions_security.yml.

Hunt for: FortiOS system.auto-script objects with traversal strings in their names; Atlassian requests containing "::" and unexpected admin accounts created via Crowd; GitHub workflows named security-audit.yml or github_actions_security.yml.
